bagPolicy.summary: Bags, backpacks or briefcases larger than 5 × 7 inches are prohibited. All bags are searched and guests pass a walk-through metal detector.
allowed: Small personal bag up to 5 × 7 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Parking is shared with the Hollywood resort. The current resort FAQ lists $40 valet parking on Hard Rock Live event nights; check the event for self-parking arrangements.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
